entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A war-torn plane inspired by eastern and central Asia, ruled by five clans and, for thousands of years, by five draconic broods.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon and twin of Nicol Bolas who shaped Tarkir; his wing beats birthed the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, a planeswalker dragon who tracked his brother to Tarkir and mortally wounded him in a titanic battle.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker plagued by Ugin's whispers, sent back in time through the Nexus of Fate, who later gains control of the wild dragons.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Restoration awoke Ugin; he introduced a type of vampire to Tarkir.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A former planeswalker who leads the rebellion and performs the Stormnexus Ritual to end the dragonlords' reign.

entities.name: Alniul
entities.description: The Twice Whisperer of the Temur who helps Narset uncover the Stormnexus Ritual scroll.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A spell perhaps as old as the Multiverse that calls forth the soul of Tarkir and bound spirit dragons to the new clan leaders.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Elemental storms born of Ugin's influence from which dragons are born fully formed.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The event in which the growing dragons overtook the clans and five dragonlords rose to dominate Tarkir.

entities.name: Nexus of Fate
entities.description: A time-spanning route through which Ugin's spirit transported Sarkhan back in time.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: Five tyrannical Elder Dragons who led the draconic broods and dominated the clans until the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord whose brood was revered by the Abzan Houses.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragonlord whose brood was admired by the Jeskai Way.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dragonlord whose snake-headed brood inspired the Sultai Brood.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The dragonlord whose lightning-conjuring brood was imitated by the Mardu Horde.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The hungry, barely sapient dragonlord whose brood was honored by the Temur Frontier.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: A clan of the Shifting Wastes whose tradition of calling on ancestral spirits was attacked by Dromoka.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: A clan of Tiansun based on Shaolin monks, admired by Ojutai's brood.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A clan of the Gudul delta that made a pact with Silumgar.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: A semi-nomadic clan of the Sandsteppe imitated by Kolaghan's brood.

entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: A nomadic clan of the Qal Sisma honored by Atarka's brood.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: The Abzan khan who was brought before Dromoka and ordered the end of the kin-tree traditions.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A Jeskai figure whose terms of surrender Ojutai accepted.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: A Sultai khan who betrayed the other khans to Silumgar and became his pet.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: A Temur leader who fed Atarka mammoth carcasses to protect her clan.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: A Temur figure who helped defend Tarkir against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Goreclaw
entities.description: A figure who helped defend Tarkir against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: A Mardu figure who helped defend Tarkir against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that targeted Tarkir and weakened the dragonlords' grip.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Tarkir who compleated many dragons.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Dragons formed from the five dragon spirits bound to the new clan leaders in the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Wild dragons
entities.description: Dragons spawned by the strengthened dragonstorms that refuse any authority.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: The ruins where the rebellion leaders performed the Stormnexus Ritual.

events.summary: Ugin arrives on a half-born Tarkir after his rebirth and forms its landscape, creatures and peoples; his wing beats birth the dragonstorms.
events.quote: his wing beats birthed the dragonstorms .

events.summary: In 3279 AR Nicol Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir and the two fight, leaving Ugin mortally wounded.
events.quote: The two planeswalkers waged a titanic battle, leaving Ugin mortally wounded.

events.summary: Ugin's spirit sends Sarkhan back through the Nexus of Fate to prevent the dragon's death; Ugin is preserved in a hedron cocoon.
events.quote: Ugin was preserved in a hedron cocoon as he regained his strength.

events.summary: The Khanfall: dragon tempests grow and dragons overtake the clans, five dragonlords and their broods rise to dominate the humanoid races.
events.quote: five dragonlords and their broods rose to dominate the humanoid races

events.summary: Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin and he leaves Tarkir in 4559 AR, lessening the dragonstorms.
events.quote: the spirit dragon departed Tarkir in 4559 AR, the dragonstorms, no longer empowered by his essence, finally lessened.

events.summary: In the original timeline Ugin dies, the dragonstorms cease, and the clans destroy all the dragons.
events.quote: Ugin was killed in the confrontation with his brother.

events.summary: Tarkir is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion; many dragons are compleated or killed.
events.quote: many dragons were compleated and a substantial number were killed.

events.summary: Weakened dragonlords face growing open rebellions under the old clan banners.
events.quote: The humanoid rebellions were able to gain traction

events.summary: Narset and Alniul find the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and Narset is persuaded by the other rebellion leaders to use it.
events.quote: was convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir.

events.summary: At the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon the ritual calls up a dragonstorm; Narset leaps onto a spirit and shapes it, and the dragon spirits are bound to the new clan leaders.
events.quote: In a flash of power, the dragon spirits and what would become the new clan leaders were bound.

events.summary: The dragonlords fight the new spirit dragons and are defeated, seemingly swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: In the end, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

events.summary: The ritual strengthens the dragonstorms and thousands of wild dragons spawn.
events.quote: resulting in thousands of a new, powerful kind of wild dragon spawning.

events.summary: Narset proposes an accord between the clans, but disagreements stall it.
events.quote: Narset proposed an accord between the clans

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol gains control of the wild dragons with a distorted Stormnexus Ritual but is defeated by Ugin's return, and Ugin retakes the dragonstorms.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol gained control of the wild dragons, but he was defeated by the timely return of Ugin .

events.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan until Khan Daghatar is brought before her and ends the kin-tree traditions.
events.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons.

events.summary: Ojutai accepts Shu Yun's surrender, has Jeskai ghostfire warriors executed, and rewrites Jeskai records.
events.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior.

events.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting place to Silumgar and becomes his pet.
events.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing to Silumgar the location of their meeting

events.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses, saving the Temur from attack.
events.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses
